text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san!
Thank you for the time off.
choice_data_list: Did you have a good break?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ I had a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Actually, I happened to run into an elderly lady in town whom I had previously given directions to.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
When I greeted them,
they were so delighted.
They even said, 'It must be fate that brought us together'...
choice_data_list: Wow, you figured out who it was!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Since you're someone I've already spoken with, of course♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I've received so many supportive words,
so I'm going to give it my all again starting today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: May this precious connection become something of even greater value.

It looks like Victoire Pisa
had a truly fulfilling day off!
